title: Golf ball lands on Frederick Wolfe's grave
place_text: Fort Knox golf course cemetery, Kentucky

tellings.quote: And it says Frederick Wolfe. >> [sighs] >> German soldier died

plain: Rolf Mowatt-Larssen, a former senior CIA officer, says that in 1976 he was playing golf at Fort Knox, an Army base in Kentucky whose course has a small cemetery on it. He says his ball landed on a grave whose marker read Frederick Wolfe, a German soldier who had died there. He tells it as a striking coincidence that seemed to mean something to him.
